title_en: The Stance of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them) Regarding Insulting and Cursing the Sacred Matters of Others
description_en: The stance of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them) regarding insulting and cursing the sacred matters of others. An excerpt from the program (Debates in Creed) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure), 8 Jumada al-Thani 1434 AH.
summary: This video highlights the ethical approach and instructions of the Ahl al-Bayt concerning sectarian abuse and insulting other religious groups' sanctities.
